floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_partial_grp.what: fgw_partial with the share s taken from the overlap of the brackets' anchors' group distributions (the lineage map's group, the level fgw_potts reads) in place of their celltype distributions; the solver, its arguments, the costs, alpha, an unmatched anchor, the rotation, the draws, the streams and the expression are fgw_partial's; the entry's coupling where s is exactly 1; a bracket without group labels refuses
fgw_partial_grp.label: group
choices_on_no_record: the overlap as the estimate of the share
the zero displacement of an unmatched anchor

fgw_damp_m.what: fgw with every anchor's displacement of a bracket multiplied by one factor of that bracket: the mean over the bracket's cells of the norm of the k-anchor mean displacement under fgw_partial's coupling on the same anchors, over the entry's; the entry's balanced coupling, directions, partners and rotation
fgw_damp_m.label: celltype

fgw_damp_m_grp.what: fgw_damp_m with its two factors taken from fgw_partial_grp's coupling (the brackets' anchors' group labels) in place of fgw_partial's (their celltype labels); the entry's balanced coupling, directions, partners, rotation, draws, streams and expression; the entry where the group overlap is exactly 1; a bracket without group labels refuses
fgw_damp_m_grp.label: group
